# The Medical Journal of Australia

> Australia's leading peer-reviewed medical journal publishing clinical research, guidelines, and medical commentary across all specialties.

The Medical Journal of Australia (MJA) is the official journal of the Australian Medical Association, providing healthcare professionals with evidence-based research, clinical guidance, and medical news. The journal maintains a comprehensive archive of articles organized by medical specialty topics and offers subscription access for both individual practitioners and institutions.

## Core Journal Access

- [Homepage](https://www.mja.com.au): MJA homepage with article archive, topic browsing, and subscription access
- [Journal Archive](https://www.mja.com.au/journal): Complete MJA article archive with topic categories and research database
- [Subscribe](https://www.mja.com.au/subscribe): Subscription pricing and access options for MJA personal and institutional plans

## Publishing & Submission

- [Instructions for Authors and Reviewers](https://www.mja.com.au/journal/instructions-authors-reviewers): Author and reviewer guidelines, submission process, and calls for papers

## Current Issues

- [Volume 224, Issue 2](https://www.mja.com.au/journal/2026/224/2): MJA Volume 224 Issue 2 featuring clinical guidelines and medical research

## Clinical News & Commentary

- [InSight+](https://insightplus.mja.com.au): InSight+ healthcare news, clinical guidance, and medical commentary platform

## Medical Specialty Topics

- [COVID-19](https://www.mja.com.au/journal/topics/COVID-19): COVID-19 topic archive with infectious disease research and medical literature
- [Cardiovascular Diseases](https://www.mja.com.au/journal/topics/Cardiovascular diseases): Cardiovascular diseases topic collection with research articles and clinical content
- [Emergency Medicine](https://www.mja.com.au/journal/topics/Emergency medicine): Emergency medicine topic collection with clinical practice research articles
- [Endocrinology](https://www.mja.com.au/journal/topics/Endocrinology): Endocrinology topic archive with endocrine disease medical research
- [Digestive System Diseases](https://www.mja.com.au/journal/topics/Digestive system diseases): Digestive system diseases and gastroenterology topic archive
- [Anesthesia, Analgesia and Pain](https://www.mja.com.au/journal/topics/Anesthesia, analgesia and pain): Topic collection for anesthesia, analgesia, and pain management research
- [Anatomy and Physiology](https://www.mja.com.au/journal/topics/Anatomy and physiology): Topic archive for anatomy and physiology articles from MJA
- [Diagnostic Techniques and Procedures](https://www.mja.com.au/journal/topics/Diagnostic techniques and procedures): Diagnostic techniques and procedures topic archive from MJA
- [Endocrine System Diseases](https://www.mja.com.au/journal/topics/Endocrine system diseases): Endocrine system diseases topic archive with clinical research content
- [Drug Overdose](https://www.mja.com.au/journal/topics/Drug overdose): Drug overdose topic archive covering toxicology and substance abuse research
- [Drug-Related Side Effects and Adverse Reactions](https://www.mja.com.au/journal/topics/Drug‐related side effects and adverse reactions): Drug side effects and adverse reactions topic with pharmacovigilance literature
- [Environment and Public Health](https://www.mja.com.au/journal/topics/Environment and public health): Environment and public health topic collection with research articles
- [Complementary Therapies](https://www.mja.com.au/journal/topics/Complementary therapies): Complementary therapies topic archive with alternative medicine research
